mapper.select: SELECT id, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, deleted, version, user_id AS userId, wordbook_id AS wordbookId, scenario_code AS scenarioCode, graph_nodes_json AS graphNodesJson, graph_edges_json AS graphEdgesJson, bag_terms_json AS bagTermsJson FROM learning_rumination_graph WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND wordbook_id = #{wordbookId} AND scenario_code = #{scenarioCode} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
